data.songTitle: Alex Crichton – Merry Christmas, i miss you
data.plainLyric:
You walked in the party, your coat was untied
Slammin' the door 'cause it's colder outside
Now I won't forget that moment like the blink of an eye
You're off to the beach now 'til the weather gets nice

But what if I call
And you pick up the phone?
And I use this holiday
To make my way to your ghost

Or what if you're lonely
And you know I am too?
And I get the chance to say
"Merry Christmas, I miss you"
I miss you

So I'll hang the lights, hope you'll see them from space
And all that I want on my list is that look on your face
When I said, "November's early to be playing these songs"
Now when I look back, I can see I was wrong

So what if I call
And you pick up the phone?
And I use this holiday
To make my way to your ghost

Or what if you're lonely
And you know I am too?
And I get the chance to say
"Merry Christmas, I miss you"
I miss you

You know it's true
That I miss you
You know it's true

So what if I call
And you pick up the phone?
And I use this holiday
To make my way to your ghost

Or what if you're lonely
And you know I am too?
And I get the chance to say
"Merry Christmas, I miss you"
I miss you
